hero.title: Learn Sign Language
hero.subtitle: The platform lets you learn sign languages from many countries. Have fun, practice, and communicate with the Deaf community.

features.title: Why our platform?
features.subtitle: We offer a complete experience to learn and practice different sign languages with ease.

easySignup.title: Easy signup
easySignup.body: Sign up and access all content. Track your progress across different levels.

multilang.title: Multilingual
multilang.body: Access sign language lessons from different countries and regions.

interactive.title: Interactive material
interactive.body: Learn with videos, practical exercises, and assessments that help you consolidate knowledge.

ranking.title: Ranking and motivation
ranking.body: Compete friendly with other users, climb the ranking, and stay motivated to keep learning.

collaborate.title: Want to add a new language?
collaborate.body: Our platform is growing. If you represent a school, association, or are an expert who wants to upload sign language lessons from your country, we want to collaborate with you!
